content_sections.heading: CG Apex Bank Co-operative Intern at a Glance

rows.details: Chhattisgarh State Cooperative Bank Limited Raipur

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Co-operative Intern position located at the District Central Cooperative Bank, Jagdalpur.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess an MBA or equivalent in Marketing Management, Cooperative Management, Agri-Business Management, or Rural Development Management. Additionally, computer proficiency is compulsory for all applicants. Candidates must have completed 21 years of age and not be older than 30 years as on 01.01.2026. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Selected interns receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 25,000/- along with a travelling allowance (TA/DA) as per rules in their respective bank. Interns can take up to 10 days of casual leave in a year, with no other paid leave provided except unpaid medical leave as per applicable bank rules. The appointment is strictly for a period of one year.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CG Apex Bank Co-operative Intern
content_sections.text: Download the application form and notification from the official website cgapexbank.com. Fill out the application form carefully with all required personal and educational details and attach a self-attested passport-size photograph. Enclose self-attested photocopies of Aadhaar card, high school marksheet, higher secondary marksheet, graduation degree, post-graduation degree, computer qualification certificates, and any other relevant qualification documents. Write "को-ऑपरेटिव इंटरन की नियुक्ति हेतु आवेदन" in bold letters on the top of the envelope. Send the completed application by Registered or Speed Post to the Managing Director, Chhattisgarh Rajya Sahakari Bank Maryadit, Raipur, Headquarters "Sahakar Bhavan", Plot No.-74, Sector-24, Atal Nagar, Nawa Raipur (C.G.) 492002 to reach on or before 26 October 2026 by 5:30 PM.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is based on a merit list prepared according to percentages obtained in High School, Higher Secondary, Graduation, Post-Graduation, and additional qualifications, with academic weightage marks up to a maximum of 50. Selected candidates must undergo document verification and present a medical fitness certificate from a District Hospital Medical Board before joining.

faq.question: Q1. Is the Co-operative Intern post permanent or on contract, and for how long?
faq.answer: The appointment is on a contract basis for a fixed duration of one year only.

faq.question: Q2. Are there any allowances paid on top of the consolidated pay?
faq.answer: Interns receive Rs. 25,000/- per month along with a travelling allowance (TA/DA) as determined for each bank.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit and cut-off date to apply?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 21 and 30 years of age as on 01.01.2026.

faq.question: Q4. Which documents must be enclosed with the offline application?
faq.answer: Applicants must enclose self-attested photocopies of their Aadhaar card, high school certificate, higher secondary certificate, graduation degree, post-graduation degree, and computer qualification certificates.
